cmsy_mcmc(): CMSY++运行的MCMC设置与收敛诊断

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/cmsy_mcmc.Rmd
cmsy_mcmc.Rmd

英文原页：cmsy_mcmc()

说明

该函数显示每次CMSY++运行的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）是怎样设置的，以及各条链是否收敛。CMSY++用JAGS（Plummer 2003）拟合贝叶斯状态空间Schaefer模型，所用的设置是n.chains、n.iter、n.burnin和n.thin（见cmsy_defaults()；CMSY++16.R默认2条链，每条迭代60,000次，前30,000次作为预烧舍弃，之后每10次保留1次）。cmsy_run()保存主要参数每条链的抽样，模型本身不作任何改动。

English

This function shows how the Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) of each CMSY++ run was set up and whether its chains converged. CMSY++ fits its Bayesian state-space Schaefer model with JAGS (Plummer 2003), here with the settings n.chains, n.iter, n.burnin and n.thin (see cmsy_defaults(); CMSY++16.R uses 2 chains of 60,000 iterations, the first 30,000 discarded as burn-in and every 10th kept). cmsy_run() keeps the draws of each chain of the main parameters; nothing of the model is changed.

用法 

cmsy_mcmc(
  result,
  stocks = NULL,
  rhat_max = 1.1,
  n_eff_min = 400,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  colors = NULL,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = fao_setting("pptx"),
  silent = fao_setting("silent")
)

参数

result
cmsy_run()（或cmsy_area()）的结果。
English The result of cmsy_run() (or cmsy_area()).
stocks
要显示的种群（可选）：种群代码，或物种的英文名、中文名、学名或FAO三字母代码。默认为NULL，即所有运行过的种群。
English Optional stocks: Stock identifiers or species, by English or Chinese FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code. Default is NULL, all stocks that ran.
rhat_max
视为收敛的最大Rhat。默认为1.1。
English Largest Rhat taken as converged. Default is 1.1.
n_eff_min
视为足够的最小有效样本量（所有链合计）。默认为400。
English Smallest effective sample size (all chains together) taken as enough. Default is 400.
plot
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，把每个种群的轨迹与密度图保存在figures/png/cmsy/<种群>/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the trace and density chart of each stock is saved in figures/png/cmsy/<stock>/.
table
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，把两张表保存在tables/cmsy/（mcmc_settings.csv和mcmc_diagnostics.csv）。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the two tables are saved in tables/cmsy/ (mcmc_settings.csv and mcmc_diagnostics.csv).
colors
图中各条链的颜色：NULL（默认）为色盲友好的Okabe-Ito配色（蓝、朱红、绿……）；也可以是调色板名称（fao_settings(palette = )支持的任何调色板，如”npg”、“Set1”、“Tableau 10”或”viridis”），或每条链一个颜色的向量（如c("black", "#D7191C")）；颜色少于链数时按插值补足。
English Colours of the chains in the chart: NULL (default) for the colour-blind safe Okabe-Ito colours (blue, vermilion, green, …), the name of a palette (any palette of fao_settings(palette = ), e.g. “npg”, “Set1”, “Tableau 10” or “viridis”), or a vector of colours, one per chain (e.g. c("black", "#D7191C")); with fewer colours than chains, colours are interpolated.
lang
图表文字和参数名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即fao_settings()设置的语言。
English The language of the chart text and parameter names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both”. Default is NULL, the language set with fao_settings().
pptx
逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件。默认为fao_settings()中的设置（未更改时为FALSE）。
English A logical value. If TRUE, the charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files. Default is the value set with fao_settings() (FALSE unless changed).
silent
逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，报告未收敛或有效样本量不足的种群和参数。可以用fao_settings(silent = TRUE)更改默认值。
English A logical value. If FALSE (default), the stocks and parameters that did not converge or have too few effective draws are reported. Default can be changed with fao_settings(silent = TRUE).

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含settings（每个种群一行：n_chains、n_iter、n_burnin、n_thin、每条链保留的抽样数n_kept和抽样总数n_draws）、diagnostics（每个种群每个参数一行：mean、sd、lcl、median、ucl、rhat、n_eff、converged（Rhat不超过rhat_max）和enough_draws（有效样本量不少于n_eff_min））以及plots（ggplot对象）。

English

Invisibly, a list with settings (one row per stock: n_chains, n_iter, n_burnin, n_thin, n_kept per chain and n_draws in all), diagnostics (one row per stock and parameter: mean, sd, lcl, median, ucl, rhat, n_eff, converged (Rhat at most rhat_max) and enough_draws (effective sample size at least n_eff_min)) and plots (the ggplot objects).

详细说明

对r、k、MSY（按CMSY++16.R的算法为r k / 4）、第一年和最后一年的B/k、最后一年的B/Bmsy和F/Fmsy以及偏差（deviance），函数给出后验均值、标准差和95%区间，Gelman和Rubin（1992）的潜在尺度缩减因子Rhat（用coda::gelman.diag()计算），以及所有链合计的有效样本量（用coda::effectiveSize()计算；Plummer等，2006）。Rhat比较链间方差和链内方差，接近1说明各条链已经混合：Rhat不超过rhat_max（1.1，Gelman等，2013）时视为收敛。有效样本量是自相关的抽样相当于多少个独立抽样；低于n_eff_min（400，Vehtari等，2021）时，95%区间不够精确。按CMSY++16.R的设置，r和k的抽样自相关很强，有效样本量常常只有几百；加长链并增加链数可以提高有效样本量，例如cmsy_run(settings = list(n.chains = 4, n.iter = 300000, n.burnin = 150000, n.thin = 50))，运行时间约为原来的五倍。链收敛并不说明先验或模型适合该种群。

plot = TRUE时，每个种群画一张图，按保留顺序显示每条链的抽样（轨迹）及其密度，参数为r、k、MSY和最后一年的B/k，保存为figures/png/cmsy/<种群>/mcmc.png；这也是cmsy_plot()的”mcmc”图。

English

For r, k, MSY (r k / 4, as CMSY++16.R computes it), B/k in the first and last years, B/Bmsy and F/Fmsy in the last year and the deviance, the function gives the posterior mean, standard deviation and 95% interval, the potential scale reduction factor Rhat of Gelman and Rubin (1992), computed with coda::gelman.diag(), and the effective sample size of all chains together, computed with coda::effectiveSize() (Plummer et al. 2006). Rhat compares the variance between chains with the variance within chains; values near 1 mean the chains have mixed: a parameter is taken as converged when Rhat is at most rhat_max (1.1, Gelman et al. 2013). The effective sample size is the number of independent draws the autocorrelated draws are worth; below n_eff_min (400, Vehtari et al. 2021) the 95% limits are imprecise. With the settings of CMSY++16.R the draws of r and k are strongly autocorrelated, and their effective sample size is often a few hundred; longer and more chains raise it, e.g. cmsy_run(settings = list(n.chains = 4, n.iter = 300000, n.burnin = 150000, n.thin = 50)), which takes about five times as long. Converged chains do not mean that the priors or the model fit the stock.

With plot = TRUE, a chart of each stock shows the draws of each chain in the order they were kept (trace) and their densities, for r, k, MSY and the last-year B/k, saved as figures/png/cmsy/<stock>/mcmc.png; it is also the “mcmc” chart of cmsy_plot().

参考文献

Gelman, A. and Rubin, D.B. (1992). Inference from iterative simulation using multiple sequences. Statistical Science 7(4): 457-472. doi:10.1214/ss/1177011136

Gelman, A., Carlin, J.B., Stern, H.S., Dunson, D.B., Vehtari, A. and Rubin, D.B. (2013). Bayesian Data Analysis, 3rd edition. Boca Raton: CRC Press. doi:10.1201/b16018

Plummer, M. (2003). JAGS: A program for analysis of Bayesian graphical models using Gibbs sampling. Proceedings of the 3rd International Workshop on Distributed Statistical Computing (DSC 2003), Vienna, Austria.

Plummer, M., Best, N., Cowles, K. and Vines, K. (2006). CODA: convergence diagnosis and output analysis for MCMC. R News 6(1): 7-11. https://journal.r-project.org/articles/RN-2006-002/

Vehtari, A., Gelman, A., Simpson, D., Carpenter, B. and Buerkner, P.-C. (2021). Rank-normalization, folding, and localization: an improved Rhat for assessing convergence of MCMC. Bayesian Analysis 16(2): 667-718. doi:10.1214/20-BA1221

另请参阅

cmsy_defaults() for the MCMC settings, cmsy_run() to change them.

示例 

result <- cmsy_area("Atlantic, Northeast", top = 10)
mcmc <- cmsy_mcmc(result, lang = "zh")

# Chains in other colours: a palette, or one colour per chain
cmsy_mcmc(result, colors = "Set1")
cmsy_mcmc(result, colors = c("grey30", "#D7191C"))
mcmc$settings
mcmc$diagnostics[!mcmc$diagnostics$converged, ]

# Longer chains for a stock that did not converge
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "PRA_27", seed = 1,
                   settings = list(n.iter = 200000, n.burnin = 100000, n.thin = 20))
cmsy_mcmc(result)
